description.message: Fill in and save logins with your VaultRust password safe. Works with the VaultRust app for Windows; your vault never leaves your computer.

commandFill.message: Fill in the login for this site

noSite.message: Open a website to fill in one of its logins.

addLogin.message: Add a login for this site

noForm.message: There is no login form on this page that VaultRust can fill in.

shortcutHint.message: Tip: Alt+Shift+L fills in the most recently used login. Logins also appear when you click into a login field.

noPasswordField.message: No password field on this page

generatorHint.message: Made by VaultRust with your generator settings, following the password rules you set for this site.

generateHint.message: Strong and new, following this site's rules

notSetUpTitle.message: VaultRust isn't set up for this browser

notSetUp.message: In VaultRust, open Settings → Browser extension and turn it on.

notRunning.message: Start it to fill in your logins.

disabledTitle.message: The browser extension is turned off

disabled.message: Turn it on in VaultRust under Settings → Browser extension.

unpaired.message: Click the VaultRust button in the toolbar to connect it.

locked.message: Unlock it to see your logins.

busy.message: Finish what's open in VaultRust first.

noReply.message: It may be busy with a dialog. Try again in a moment.

connect.message: VaultRust asks you once to allow this browser to fill in and save your logins.

confirm.message: VaultRust is asking whether to connect this browser. Allow it there if it shows this code:

saveTitle.message: Save this login for $HOST$ in VaultRust?

updateTitle.message: Update the password of “$TITLE$” in VaultRust?

updateText.message: You signed in as $USER$ with a different password.

saveAfterUnlock.message: Unlock VaultRust, then click Save again.
